title: H.264 in-loop deblocking filter (clause 8.7) behind N2AVC_F_DEBLOCK

api.header: none new (include/ is frozen); the function is declared by the caller
api.signature: void n2avc_deblock_picture(n2avc_frame *rec, const n2avc_mbinfo *mb, int mb_w, int mb_h)
api.thread_safe: yes: no globals; called after the slice threads join, writes only rec
api.imports: none for iOS arm64 (no libc call)

implemented: clause 8.7.2.1 bS: 4 (MB edge, intra), 3 (other intra), 2 (either luma 4x4 has coefficients), 1 (ref or mv difference >= 4 quarter samples), 0
chroma bS inherited from the luma edge at (2*x, 2*y), per position
alpha/beta Table 8-16, t'C0 Table 8-17, QP_C Table 8-15, qPav, filterSamplesFlag 8-470
8.7.2.3 filters for bS < 4 including the luma p1/q1 update and the chroma tC = tC0 + 1 rule
8.7.2.4 filters for bS = 4 with separate p-side and q-side strong conditions and the weak fallback
normative order: raster MBs; per MB luma/Cb/Cr; per component vertical left->right then horizontal top->bottom
picture-boundary edges skipped; edges between slices filtered (disable_deblocking_filter_idc 0)
I_PCM qPz = 0 and QPC(QPY=0) per clause 8.7.2 (not emitted by the current core)
